assets.name: antiquary-doublet
assets.description: Ochre floral brocade Tudor doublet with gold-thread trim, oxblood velvet slashed sleeves lined in bone linen, and a fitted bone linen neck stock.

assets.name: antiquary-monocle
assets.description: A gold-rimmed monocle on the near eye (1040, 912), with an open lens interior and a narrow oxblood silk ribbon trailing to the lapel.

assets.name: antiquary-scroll
assets.description: A rolled parchment tied with moss ribbon and an oxblood wax seal, gripped in an oxblood leather glove at the lower left.
